limitations: Team totals use the pack's extras run values (v2 pack); official run margins are reproduced exactly in about 99% of matches. The few remaining gaps are DLS-adjusted results.
Winners are reconstructed from the chase structure (legal balls and wickets are exact).
Pressure samples are small (eligibility starts at 120 pressure balls); shrinkage pulls small samples toward the role average, and the bootstrap intervals show the remaining uncertainty.
T20I includes associate nations; balls involving associates are down-weighted (0.5).
IPL 2023+ is the impact-player era; batting depth and bowling usage changed mid-sample.
No pitch, weather, injury or match-up intent data; context models use phase, wickets, required rate, pace/spin, batting hand, competition and opposition tier only.
Rain-reduced matches are excluded from WP training and ratings.
